title: Compliance Holdback on FBN Warehouse-Loss Approvals
content:
For a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss approval, the compliance holdback is waived (0 units) for a seller with no active violation points whose standing status is good standing, is the high compliance holdback of 3 units for a seller with at least the violation-point trigger of 6 active violation points, and for every other seller is not altered by this rule.

Both readings come from the seller's Seller Performance Standing record: its active violation points and its standing status.

## Decision card

| Active violation points | Standing status | Compliance holdback |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | good standing | 0 units |
| 0 | any other status | not altered |
| 1 to 5 | any | not altered |
| 6 | any | 3 units |
| more than 6 | any | 3 units |

The waiver needs both parts at once: no active points and good standing. The high holdback turns on the points alone: 5 active points stay below the trigger, 6 reach it.
